summary: st-test runs checks that build nothing (ci-script-tests, typescript-client or genie-freshness on their own) in a throwaway worktree instead of a pool tree, so they never wait behind building runs for a tree they do not need, and runs each such check with BUILD_ADMISSION_CLASS=light so its nix develop shell starts as light, not as a heavy build admission (a building check never gets it)

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes.

rules.detail: What is signed is unchanged: the same commit, now checked out in a fresh worktree when no selected check builds; the admission class only changes how long the shell start waits.

compatibility.detail: A run with any building check (linux-gate, fractal-web, rust-tests, so every --all run) uses the pool as before.
